stories.title: Pope Leo says concerns that AI could 'destroy humanity' are not 'fake news,' in apparent rebuke of Trump
stories.reason: Speaking to reporters on his flight home from France, Leo said AI experts' warnings 'should be taken seriously' and urged dialogue to keep the technology from reaching a point where it could destroy humanity, directly contradicting Trump's dismissal of such fears as a 'hoax' at the UN last week.

stories.title: Trump meets Amodei, Zuckerberg, Huang, Musk, Pichai and Bezos on AI, rules out global regulation
stories.reason: The White House lunch with House Speaker Johnson and top AI executives came as Trump reiterated he won't 'stifle' the technology, calling superintelligence 'bigger than the Industrial Revolution,' a stance that puts him at odds with both the Pope and several of the CEOs' own public warnings about AI risk.

stories.title: CIA reportedly warns Spain, France and Italy of a possible Russian drone attack launched from disguised commercial ships
stories.reason: The alleged plan involves concealing small Gerbera drones in shipping containers to launch attacks reaching the coast within one or two hours, an unconfirmed but serious enough threat that intelligence services across the Mediterranean have been put on alert.

stories.title: US forces complete their withdrawal from Iraq's last bases after two decades, ending the military mission
stories.reason: The pullout, agreed under Biden in 2024 and completed by Trump even as Washington wages war on Iran, closes out a war that killed 4,500 Americans and is being celebrated by Tehran's allies, with Iraqi security officials warning it could open the door to a resurgent ISIS and deeper Iranian influence.

stories.title: Myanmar military airstrike on a Rakhine state market kills at least 49 people
stories.reason: Fighter jets dropped bombs on Kyauktaw's wholesale market in Arakan Army-held territory, killing vendors and shoppers and wounding 58 others, the latest mass-casualty strike in the junta's campaign against ethnic armed groups since its 2021 coup.

stories.title: US consumer confidence dives to its lowest level in more than 12 years
stories.reason: The Conference Board's index tumbled to 81.9 as its Expectations sub-index fell to 63.6 -- a level historically associated with a recession within a year -- with more Americans for the first time in four years calling their finances 'bad' rather than 'good.'

stories.title: Arm Holdings plunges 8.7% as Wall Street's AI-stock slide deepens for a third day
stories.reason: The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all fell again as elevated oil prices from the US-Iran standoff keep pushing Treasury yields higher, with chip stocks bearing the brunt as investors grow more cautious on stretched AI valuations.

stories.title: Cornell fraternity rape case reopened for grand jury review as Governor Hochul calls for outside probe
stories.reason: Tompkins County's DA reversed his earlier decision not to charge seven Chi Phi members after a new lawsuit detailed a 2024 assault, prompting Hochul to demand an independent review of Cornell's response and New York's attorney general to examine the university's handling of the case.
